These are the unmodified, small metadata sidecars distributed with PDS product
`AVGVISIB_65S_240M_201608`:

- `avgvisib_65s_240m_201608_jp2.lbl`
- `avgvisib_65s_240m_201608_aux.xml`

Source:
`https://pds-geosciences.wustl.edu/lro/lro-l-lola-3-rdr-v1/lrolol_1xxx/extras/illumination/jp2/`

They were retrieved on 2026-10-12. The 48.6 MB JP2 and other science data are
deliberately not fixtures and remain excluded from version control.
